meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: Claude 会按任务需要动态组建由执行、指挥、评审三类智能体组成的团队,展示它们辩论与决策的全过程,所有智能体共享同一份上下文记忆,最后汇总输出统一的协作结果与方案。
howto.when: 当你需要多个智能体协同完成一项任务,或要为某类场景管理一组智能体时触发;也可以直接说「请用技术决策团队评估……」等预设团队调用语进入。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构的可行性
say.note: 主持人引导各智能体发言、辩论并形成共识

say.text: 请用OPC团队构建AI短视频领域的系统
say.note: 战略分析、产品架构、自动化工程三个智能体串行输出

say.text: 请用产品团队制定这款产品的定价策略
say.note: 市场分析师与财务顾问讨论后给出定价方案

howto.what_en: Claude dynamically assembles a team of execution, command and review agents for a task, shows their debate and decision process, lets them share one context memory, and delivers a consolidated result.
howto.when_en: Use it when a task needs several agents working together, or when you want to manage an agent group for a specific scenario; preset team calls like "use the technical decision team" also start it.

say_en.text: Use the technical decision team to evaluate a microservices architecture
say_en.note: A host guides the agents' debate to a consensus

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for AI short videos
say_en.note: Strategy, product architecture and automation agents run in sequence

say_en.text: Use the product team to set a pricing strategy for this product
say_en.note: Market and finance agents discuss, then propose pricing
